info.title: Calculate Refund
info.description: Use this API to estimate the refundable amount for a cancellation, refund, or return-and-refund request. The estimate depends on the selected request_type, reason_name, and targeted items. For return-and-refund scenarios, the estimate can also depend on the selected return shipping method.

post.description: Use this API to estimate the refundable amount for a cancellation, refund, or return-and-refund request. parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

request_type.description:
Request type
- CANCEL
- REFUND
- RETURN_AND_REFUND
Note: different request types are used for different aftersales scenarios. Also, different request types might have different refund amounts, because the refund amount calculation policy is different.

shipment_type.description:
How buyer ships items to seller when in a return request, could be:
- `PLATFORM`
- `BUYER_ARRANGE`

handover_method.description:
Which handover method buyer chooses to use when returning goods to seller by platform
- `DROP_OFF`: buyer drops off the parcel in logistics service collect point.
- `PICKUP`: logistics service picks up the buyer package.

reason_name.description: Seller's reason to create a return. Use the [Get Aftersale Eligibility](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/69c3070c66dee40493fdfe2e) endpoint to retrieve the currently available reasons, and submit the returned reason name in this field.

order_line_item_ids.description: TikTok Shop order line item ids.

sku_id.description: Quantity seller wants to create a return request.

quantity.description: Sku id seller wants to create a return request.

sub_order_line_item_id.description:
The sub-order-line ID inside a bundle product
- Required for bundle products
- Not required for non-bundle products

order_line_list.description: This new parameter is completely backward compatible with the previous order_line_items_ids field and in addition this supports bundle order splitting, use the sub items accordingly

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

refund_subtotal.description: Total price of item be returned.

retail_delivery_fee.description: Retail delivery fee takes effect once platform GMV exceeds 500,000 USD, according to US Colorado states' compliance rules.
